description: Add a Goal to the end of the Roadmap, with an optional Task list and Outcome; with claim: true, also claim it to start work. A title another Goal already has is refused unless allow_duplicate is set. To record work already finished, set done on the Goal and on every Task. Plan each Goal with an Outcome (one sentence on what done looks like) and Tasks that each have a short title, the files they touch, a one-line summary and an estimate. Tell the Developer the plan in a few plain lines first. With claim: true the answer is the whole status.

allow_duplicate.description: Add the Goal even though another Goal has the same title.

claim.description: Claim the new Goal straight away, to start working on it.

done.description: Record a Goal that is already finished. Every Task must then have done: true.

estimate.description: How long the whole Goal should take, such as '6h', when its Tasks are not estimated one by one yet. Without it, the Goal's estimate is the sum of its Tasks'.

id.description: A short ID for the Goal's refs, such as 'web-ui': lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Made from the title when left out.

outcome.description: What done looks like, in one sentence, such as 'Users can sign in with Google and stay signed in for 30 days'.

project.description: Another project's plan to use instead of this one's: its name or ID on the dashboard, or its folder's full path. Changes there are marked as made from this project. Leave out for this project.

code.description: Files the Task touches, optionally with :line.

done.description: Add the Task already done, for work finished before it was recorded.

estimate.description: How long it should take, such as '45m', '2h' or '1h 30m'. Give one for every Task you plan; the dashboard's schedule is built from them.

summary.description: One or two sentences on the fix or change the Task makes, such as 'Callback re-sets the session cookie on every hit; only set it after token exchange.'

title.description: A short title for the Task, a few words, such as 'Fix callback redirect loop'.
A few words naming the Goal, such as 'Ship OAuth login'.

name: add_goal
title: Add Goal
